questions.concept: HTTP action storage accepts the request Blob without text conversion
questions.question: What does the caller download?

options.text: The UTF-8 bytes for the JSON array [0,255,128,65].
options.rationale: Neither request.blob nor store serializes the bytes as a JSON array.
The HTTP action stores the request Blob directly and the download preserves its bytes.

options.text: The body after invalid UTF-8 bytes are replaced.
options.rationale: There is no text decoding/re-encoding here; a separate text conversion control demonstrates replacement.

options.text: Nothing; storage.store is unavailable in HTTP actions.
options.rationale: HTTP action contexts expose storage.store; the endpoint successfully stores and serves the Blob.
